text:
Priya (Manager): Heads up — Taylor (full-time, SWE) resigned today. Notice given 2026-06-15, last day 2026-07-03. Want to coordinate benefits cutoff, exit interview, and a short overlap for handing off the product roadmap.
Sarah (People Ops): Thanks Priya. We need to confirm: PTO payout policy, benefits end date, COBRA eligibility, 401(k) next steps, badge and laptop return, and an exit interview time.
Taylor (Employee): Happy to help with handover. I prefer an exit interview the week after my last day, afternoons. Also I have ~12.5 hours PTO — will that be paid out?
Omar (Benefits): PTO payout: exempt FT employees get payout per contract. We'll confirm amount. Benefits end: medical and dental terminate at end of last day (07/03) and COBRA packet will be emailed within 14 days if eligible. I'll DM Taylor for enrollment history to confirm COBRA eligibility.
Sarah (People Ops): Noted. For 401(k): we'll send rollover instructions; contact info in the benefits portal.
Jake (IT): For access: propose keeping org/gh for two business days after 07/03 to finalize handover, then revoke SSO 07/06 09:00. Badge deactivation 07/06 09:00 unless earlier return needed. Laptop pickup or dropoff — Taylor, which do you prefer?
Taylor (Employee): I can drop laptop at HQ 07/06 morning between 9-11, will bring charger.
Security Ops: We'll allow drop-in 07/06 09:00-11:15 with escort. Please RSVP to facilities@redwood.co.
Priya (Manager): Could we keep a single service account token active for the small infra repo until 07/10? There's one scheduled job that needs migration.
Jake (IT): Service tokens are audited. If you need the token extended we'll need written approval from Eng Leads + Platform. Please CC it-ops@redwood.co with approval.
Nina (Recruiter): I'll start recruiting for the backfill. Priya, can you fill out the role note + expected start date? Also please request access to any interview recordings we should keep.
Priya (Manager): Will do. Expect to hire by mid-August. I'll upload interview rubrics to the hiring folder.
HRIS Bot: Offboard ticket created: https://hris.redwood.co/offboard/1814012345. Checklist auto-populated.
Sarah (People Ops): Drafted checklist: 1) Confirm last day 07/03 2) Benefits end 07/03, COBRA packet within 14 days (Omar) 3) 401(k) rollover instructions sent (Benefits) 4) PTO payout calc + final pay (Payroll Bot) 5) Badge revoke 07/06 09:00 (Security) 6) SSO/Org revoke 07/06 09:00 (IT) 7) Laptop return 07/06 drop-off (Taylor) 8) Service token extension request (Priya) 9) Exit interview scheduling (People Ops) 10) Recruiter backfill note (Nina)
Payroll Bot: PTO payout and final paycheck processed after termination date; please submit any expense reports by 07/05 to ensure inclusion. Expected final pay date: within 5 business days of invoice/expense clearance.
Omar (Benefits): Quick Q — was Taylor on spouse/domestic partner medical coverage or DOE subsidy? That affects COBRA premium notices. Taylor pls confirm.
Taylor (Employee): I'm on individual plan single coverage. No subsidy.
Sarah (People Ops): Taylor — which afternoons work for exit interview week of 07/06? We can do 07/07 or 07/08 at 2pm. It'll be a 30-min virtual with People Ops + optional manager.
Taylor (Employee): 07/07 2pm works. Virtual is fine.
Sarah (People Ops): Booked: Exit interview 2026-07-07 14:00 via Zoom (link in offboard ticket).
Priya (Manager): For knowledge transfer: I'll set up a 2-hour docwalk on 07/01 09:30-11:30 and request PR owners be reassigned. Also tagging Platform to re-schedule the cron job migration by 07/10.
Jake (IT): Reminder: back up any local credentials and push SSH keys to the team admin before wipe. We'll image laptop on receipt and archive to asset storage.
Taylor (Employee): I'll push keys and confirm which dotfiles are work-related. No personal data on work laptop per policy.
Sarah (People Ops): Final note: payroll and benefits will DM Taylor with forms. People Ops closing steps after equipment receipt and access revocation. I'll update this thread with confirmation when each step completes. :white_check_mark:
